events.title: Natural Wine Tasting
events.description: Curious about natural wine? Join us for a guided tasting of four distinctive natural wines from France, Italy and Slovakia

events.title: Unique Winemakers Tasting with Weingüter Wegeler​
events.description: An exclusive tasting of unique wines from the renowned Weingüter Wegeler, featuring Rieslings and Spätburgunders.

events.title: Champagne Tasting with Champagne Guru
events.description: Ring in the new year season with a curated selection of Champagnes, guided by the experts at Champagne Guru.

events.title: South African Wine Tasting with Cape to Cape
events.description: Explore the rich diversity of South African wines — from bold Cabernets to elegant Chenin Blancs — guided by Cape to Cape.

events.title: Small Sibling Wines: Lesser-Known Grapes from Renowned Regions
events.description: Discover high-quality, lesser-known grape varieties from famous wine regions. A tasting for the curious, guided by Bichel Vine.

events.title: Bodegas Muga Tasting with Laudrup Vin
events.description: A deep dive into the wines of Bodegas Muga, one of Rioja's most celebrated producers, presented by Laudrup Vin.

events.title: Blind Tasting: How Does One Taste Wine? with Otto Suenson
events.description: A hands-on blind tasting experience with Otto Suenson — learn to read a wine without seeing the label and develop your palate.

events.title: Pinot Noir: Ripe Richness vs. Light Elegance with Laudrup Vin
events.description: An introduction to the contrasting styles of Pinot Noir — five glasses showcasing the grape's remarkable range, guided by Laudrup Vin.

events.title: Introduction to Riesling with Manfred & Co.
events.description: A guided introduction to German Riesling — four bottles from Mittelrhein, Mosel, Baden-Württemberg, and Rheinhessen, exploring the regions and styles that make Riesling unique.
